title: 第十三章 顾家危机第十四章 屠门惨案
content_zh:
殷东正要喝止大金时，却见小宝伸出手，揪住大金的耳朵，“啊啊啊”
的叫了几声，似乎表示他的不满，而大金立马闭嘴，老实在趴下了。
“哎唷我去！
我儿子太厉害了，这么一丁点儿小就能驯狗了？”
顾文惊叹。
王海生插了句：“是东子家的这狗太有灵性了。”
“滚蛋！
明明是我儿子有灵性……”
话到一半，顾文觉得不对劲，又改口说：“啊呸呸，是我儿子天资聪颖，是个神童，对不对，儿子？”
“吃吧你，菜都要凉了。”
殷东拿着奶瓶过来，把小宝接过来一边喂牛奶，一边让王海生陪顾文先喝。
王海生抿了一口酒，赞道：“茅台的味道，就是不同。
回头我可以跟我爸和我哥他们吹个牛了。”
“我觉得白酒都一个味道，我喜欢洋酒，回头我再从老头子酒窖里顺几瓶洋酒来。”
顾文说着抿了口酒，言归正传：“东子，你说有个事要我帮忙的，什么事啊，你说。”
殷东直截了当的说：“我二叔好赌，现在应该欠了点赌债急于翻本，你找人借他一笔钱，带他去赌大一点，让他用房产证抵押。”
王海生倒吸了一口凉气，难以置信的看着殷东，有些不太认识这个好兄弟了。
顾文却十分欣赏殷东的冷酷无情，把酒杯重重的拍在桌上，赞道：“对付你二叔这种滥人，下手就是要狠。
行，这事包在我身上了。”
“文子，我要说明的是，房子得让我奶奶住到死。

我二叔输的钱，等我有了再给你。”
“东子，一世人，两兄弟，这话说得就太没意思了，你二叔的房子，本来就该是你的，房产证拿回来，肯定是过户到你名下，你爱让谁住，就让谁住。
我要你出什么钱？”
“那行，我就不矫情了，现在我也没钱。”
殷东苦笑道，把空奶瓶让小宝拿着玩，他也端起一杯酒，对顾文说：“这杯酒，我敬你，兄弟。”
“这才对了嘛。”
顾文笑着一口干了杯中酒，嘿嘿笑道：“不是我打击你，那一套两套房子的钱，哥真没看在眼里。”
“这个我信。”
殷东笑着点点头，跟他碰了一杯酒，喝了之后，脸色严肃起来，“你家的生意好，可眼红的也多。
我今天在镇上医院公厕里，就听了个小道消息，跟你爸有关。
说是有人要搞你爸。”
顾文手顿了顿，看了殷东一眼，又端起酒杯抿了一小口。
“当然，小道消息也许是假的。
你听了不要声张，反正大胆假设，小心求证，是不会错的。”
先打了个伏笔之后，殷东就把前世顾父顾浚遭手下吴冬林背叛，拿出他的涉黑走私材料举报的事情说了。
顾文爸被吴东林出卖，顾家一夕之间垮了，顾文的下场可是很惨的，被他爸的以前的手下追杀，等他得到消息赶去救下顾文时，顾文己经被砍断了一条腿，他把顾文送出国，才保住一命。
殷东说完，看顾文还在消化他说的消息，吃了两口菜，才接着曝了个猛料。
“除了吴冬林，还有一个京城的沈红雷勾结在一起了，说关于你爸的那些材料都是铁证如山，其中一项就是什么楼的屠门惨案，说是死了七个人，连三岁孩子都没放过。
后面，他们出去了，我就没听到了。”
闻言，顾文大骇，一时说不出话来。
content_en:
Just when Yin Dong was about to stop Dajin, he saw Xiaobao reaching out and grabbing Dajin's ears, "Ahhhhhh"
He screamed a few times, seeming to express his dissatisfaction, but Dajin immediately shut up and lay down.
"Hey, let me go!
My son is so awesome, can he train a dog at such a young age? "
Gu Wen was amazed.
Wang Haisheng interjected: "This dog from Dongzi's family is so spiritual."
“Get out!
Obviously my son is spiritual..."
Halfway through the words, Gu Wen felt something was wrong, so he changed his words and said, "Ah, bah, it's my son who is very talented and a child prodigy, right, son?"
"Eat it, the food is almost cold."
Yin Dong came over with a milk bottle, took Xiaobao over and fed him milk, while asking Wang Haisheng to accompany Gu Wen to drink first.
Wang Haisheng took a sip of the wine and praised: "The taste of Moutai is just different.
Later I can brag about it to my dad and my brother. "
"I think all white wines have the same taste. I like foreign wines. I'll order a few bottles of foreign wines from the old man's wine cellar later."
As he spoke, Gu Wen took a sip of his wine and returned to the topic: "Dongzi, you said you wanted me to help you with something. What is it? Tell me."
Yin Dong said straightforwardly: "My second uncle is a big gambler. Now he probably owes some gambling debts and is eager to make money. Find someone to lend him a sum of money, take him to gamble bigger, and let him use the real estate certificate as collateral."
Wang Haisheng took a breath and looked at Yin Dong in disbelief, as if he didn't quite recognize this good brother.
Gu Wen admired Yin Dong's ruthlessness very much, slammed the wine glass on the table, and praised: "When dealing with abusers like your second uncle, you have to be ruthless.
Okay, it's all on me. "
"Wenzi, what I want to explain is that my grandma must live in the house until she dies.
The money my second uncle lost will be given to you when I have it. "
"Dongzi, one generation, two brothers, this is so boring to say. Your second uncle's house should have been yours. When you get the real estate certificate back, it will definitely be transferred to your name. Whoever you want to live in can live in it.
What do I want from you? "
"Okay, I won't be pretentious, I don't have any money now."
Yin Dong smiled bitterly and let Xiaobao play with the empty milk bottle. He also picked up a glass of wine and said to Gu Wen, "I respect you for this glass of wine, brother."
"That's right."
Gu Wen smiled and drank the wine in one gulp, and said with a smile: "I'm not trying to hit you, but I really don't care about the money for two houses."
"I believe this."
Yin Dong smiled and nodded, and drank a glass of wine with him. After drinking, his face became serious, "Your business is good, but there are also many jealous people.
I heard a piece of gossip in the public toilet of the hospital in town today, and it was related to your father.
Say someone wants to mess with your dad. "
Gu Wen paused, glanced at Yin Dong, then picked up the wine glass and took a sip.
“Of course, the gossip may be false.
Don't say anything after hearing this. Anyway, if you make a bold assumption and verify it carefully, you won't be wrong. "
After making some foreshadowing, Yin Dong told the story about his father Gu Jun in his previous life, who was betrayed by his subordinate Wu Donglin and reported his gang-related smuggling materials.
Gu Wen's father was betrayed by Wu Donglin, and the Gu family collapsed overnight. Gu Wen's end was tragic. He was hunted down by his father's former men. When he got the news and rushed to rescue Gu Wen, Gu Wen had already had one of his legs cut off. He only saved his life by sending Gu Wen abroad.
After Yin Dong finished speaking, he saw that Gu Wen was still digesting the news he said. He took two bites of food before revealing the shocking news.
"In addition to Wu Donglin, there is also Shen Honglei from the capital who has colluded with each other and said that the materials about your father are all irrefutable. One of them is the massacre in the building. It is said that seven people died, including a three-year-old child.
Later, they went out and I didn't hear them. "
Hearing this, Gu Wen was shocked and speechless for a moment.
